sessions.topic: Test a lighting-augmented flow for ambiguous three-image inverse rendering
sessions.boundary_reason: Synthetic results meet both targets, and the decision shifts work to real-image validation.

sessions.topic: Prepare and report three-image DiLiGenT-MV validation of the selected flow
sessions.boundary_reason: The evaluation report completes this validation stage before another posterior model is considered.

sessions.topic: Test a gauge-aware posterior mixture against the augmented flow
sessions.boundary_reason: The mixture misses the proposed LPIPS and coverage targets; the next proposal uses diffusion.

sessions.topic: Compare conformalized gauge-fixed diffusion with the flow on held-out relighting
sessions.boundary_reason: Diffusion’s aggregate result raises a new question about specular-pixel coverage.

sessions.topic: Investigate grazing-highlight coverage and correct swapped incidence bins
sessions.boundary_reason: Corrected, roughness-stratified results resolve the apparent undercoverage and lead to a decision to retain diffusion with audits.

sessions.topic: Replicate diffusion using object-disjoint splits and corrected incidence bins
sessions.boundary_reason: The revised report completes this replication stage before the particle-distillation proposal.

sessions.topic: Benchmark roughness-calibrated posterior particles for efficient relighting
sessions.boundary_reason: The particle benchmark establishes a baseline for the subsequent lighting-marginalization proposal.

sessions.topic: Test Rao–Blackwellized particles and repair highlight-interval undercoverage
sessions.boundary_reason: Calibration restores coverage across folds, supporting adoption before testing on unseen objects.

sessions.topic: Validate adopted particles on unseen LightStage-Objects
sessions.boundary_reason: The updated relighting report completes this validation before uncertainty attribution is introduced.

sessions.topic: Validate conditional Shapley attribution against latent swaps
sessions.boundary_reason: Aggregate agreement prompts a narrower question about glossy-object rankings.

sessions.topic: Assess substantive geometry–BRDF attribution conflicts on glossy objects
sessions.boundary_reason: The decision retains aggregate attribution but requires glossy-ranking warnings and swap checks.

sessions.topic: Audit unseen glossy scenes and decide how to release predictions with attribution warnings
